text:
Jio's $60-Billion Haircut: A Crashing Market, a Musk Post and a Roadshow on the Rocks

by @palakshahjourno 

Jio Platforms' IPO was supposed to be Mukesh Ambani's victory lap, the moment India's largest telecom company showed it was worth as much as the world's top tech firms. Instead, sources and bankers say, the roadshow has turned into a hard bargaining session, and the asking price is falling fast.

At the start of the year, bankers talked about a valuation of $160 billion. That slipped to $140 billion, then $120 billion. On the roadshow this week, according to people involved in the talks, the figure being discussed is $100 billion. That is about $60 billion lost before a single share has traded.

The reason is simple. India is in its worst market downturn in years, and the big global funds Jio needs are setting the terms.

"Give us a discount"

Large institutional investors are giving Jio's bankers a blunt message, according to people familiar with the discussions. If Jio isn't offered at a steep discount, they'll get their Jio exposure by buying shares of parent company Reliance Industries.

Their benchmark is Bharti Airtel, Jio's closest listed rival. Investors are asking for a valuation about 30% below Bharti's multiples. Their argument is that a newly listed company controlled by its promoter, coming to market in a falling market, has to be priced to sell.

For Reliance this is awkward: a discount says the market won't pay Ambani's price for his crown jewel, while holding out risks a weak book.

The people who lose most: Jio's 2020 backers

The most exposed group isn't Reliance. It's the 13 global investors who put $20.3 billion into Jio in 2020: Meta, Google, Saudi Arabia's PIF, KKR, Silver Lake, Vista, Mubadala, ADIA, TPG, General Atlantic, L Catterton, Intel Capital and Qualcomm.

According to an analysis of share allotments disclosed in Jio's draft prospectus, together they hold about a third of the company. They paid ₹488 a share (Meta and Google) or ₹549 a share (the rest).

Even at $120 billion, the returns are modest. These investors would have $38.4 billion, or 1.89 times their money: about 10.9% a year in dollars over six years. That is respectable but well below what large private-equity funds usually aim for.

At $100 billion, their combined stake falls to about $32 billion and the annual dollar return drops to 7.6%. For the 11 investors who paid ₹549, which include KKR, PIF and Silver Lake, it is about 6.6%. A 30% cut from $120 billion would leave them at 3.6%, about what a US Treasury bond might have earned.

They only slip into a dollar loss at around $64–67 billion, but the point is how little they've made from one of the most hyped deals of the pandemic era.

The Rupee Has Already Taken $11 Billion

The rupee has fallen from about ₹75 to the dollar in mid-2020 to about ₹96.7 today, a 29% drop. That alone has taken about $11 billion off the 2020 investors' gains.

At the old exchange rate, their stakes would be worth about $49.6 billion at a $120 billion valuation. In rupee terms they'd be making 14–17% a year. In dollars, the currency they report in, they've lost almost 5 percentage points a year.

That explains the impasse. Having already lost billions to the currency, the 2020 investors have little reason to accept a deep discount on top.

Reliance's Return Looks Very Different

Reliance isn't in the same position. Based on prospectus data, Reliance's own investment in Jio, built largely at ₹10 a share before the 2020 fundraise, is worth about 14 times its cost in dollars. That is a return of close to 49% a year (indicative, as one payment date is not disclosed).

A discount hurts Reliance's pride. It hurts the 2020 investors' returns.

Then Came the Musk Post

On Wednesday, with the roadshow in full swing, Elon Musk weighed in. "Unfortunately, we are being blocked by certain oligarchs in order to maintain their monopolistic chokehold on the Indian people. You can guess who they are …" he posted on X. "This is a crime against the people of India!"

On Thursday, he dropped the guessing game and took Mukesh Ambani headon. 

"Starlink is licensed in over 165 countries and has spent five years complying with every single law and requirement of the government of India, so why still no license?" Musk posted. "Is Ambani the real boss of India?" It was a direct shot at the man whose company was, at that moment, asking global investors for a $100 billion valuation.

The complaint isn't new. Starlink's India launch stalled this year: the government cited security concerns, and the company was told to refund pre-orders. What has Mumbai's dealing rooms talking is the timing.

The post landed while Jio's management and bankers were in front of the same global fund managers who are already demanding a discount. A "monopolistic chokehold" is not a phrase any company wants circulating during its own IPO marketing.

There is no evidence that Musk timed the post to hurt the offering. But it puts a question in front of every investor weighing a $100 billion bet: does Jio's dominance come from competition or from regulatory protection, and how long will that protection last?

What Happens Next

The IPO is expected to open later this month. Bankers now have three options:

Price low and get the deal done, accepting that Jio lists at a big discount to Bharti and that the 2020 investors take the hit.

Hold the price and risk a weak book, which would be an embarrassment for Reliance.

Delay and wait for markets to recover, which would mean admitting that India's largest IPO has been hit by the downturn.

Each option costs someone. In 2020, the world's biggest investors queued up to buy into Ambani's digital vision. Six years later, that bet has returned less than a bond fund, a Musk post has revived the question of how Jio won its market, and new investors are demanding a discount on top.

text:
Fueling Innovation: Top 5 Government Schemes Empowering Indian Startups

Read full blog @ https://t.co/F7S2WLuWMV

Hello
 
My name is Gijo Vijayan, I am a Business coach, blogger, author and entrepreneur based at Bangalore, India.
I have many years of experience in corporate sector in Oil and Gas domain. Now I mentor startup companies all over the world. If you are interested to scale up your business, I can assist you with making strategies and solving real life problems.

I am here to help startup companies grow their business. Here are top 5 Government Schemes Empowering Indian Startups.

India’s startup landscape is among the most dynamic globally, driven by relentless innovation and ambitious entrepreneurs. However, bridging the gap between an initial breakthrough idea and commercial viability remains a formidable challenge, particularly around capital access, intellectual property protection, and market entry.

To address these hurdles, the Government of India has launched structured initiatives that provide seed funding, equity participation, collateral-free credit, and accelerator support. Below is a detailed breakdown of five flagship startup schemes in India, outlining how each operates, who qualifies, and their core benefits.

### 1. Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)

Early-stage validation is often termed the "valley of death" for startups: conventional venture capital firms prefer established traction, while bootstrapping can only go so far. The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) introduced SISFS to fund founders at the proof-of-concept stage.

* **How It Operates:** The fund is not disbursed directly to startups from a central ministry. Instead, DPIIT allocates capital to approved business incubators across India, which then evaluate and disburse funds to eligible startups.
* **Financial Assistance:**
* Up to **₹20 Lakh** as a direct grant for proof of concept (PoC), prototype development, or field trials.
* Up to **₹50 Lakh** through convertible debentures, debt, or debt-linked instruments for commercialization, product launch, and market entry.

Eligibility:** Must be a DPIIT-recognized startup incorporated within the last two years, with a viable business idea utilizing technology or innovation, and having received no more than ₹10 lakh in previous monetary support from other central or state government schemes.

2. Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)

Rather than picking individual startup winners directly, the government established the Fund of Funds model, managed through the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI).

* **How It Operates:** SIDBI acts as a "mother fund," committing capital to SEBI-registered Category I and II Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)—commonly known as venture capital funds. These partner VC funds then invest downstream into high-growth, innovative Indian startups.
* **Core Advantage:** Startups receive institutional venture capital backed by government capital without dealing with bureaucratic red tape for individual investment rounds. It significantly expands the pool of domestic venture risk capital.
* **Eligibility:** Startups must qualify under DPIIT criteria, demonstrating scalable innovation and employment potential.

3. Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)

Securing bank debt is notoriously difficult for asset-light startups, as traditional lenders mandate tangible physical collateral (such as real estate or machinery). CGSS solves this structural roadblock by providing sovereign credit guarantees to financial institutions.

* **How It Operates:** Managed by the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC), the scheme covers collateral-free credit facilities (term loans, working capital limits, and venture debt) extended to eligible startups by scheduled commercial banks, NBFCs, and AIFs.
* **Coverage Scope:** Covers credit facilities up to **₹10 Crore to ₹20 Crore** per eligible borrower, absorbing a major portion of the default risk for lenders.
* **Eligibility:** The borrower must be a DPIIT-recognized entity with demonstrated commercial traction, stable audited financials, and no defaults on existing institutional facilities.

4. SAMRIDH Scheme (MeitY)

The **Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development and Growth (SAMRIDH)** is an initiative by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) targeted at software-as-a-service (SaaS), deep tech, and tech product startups.

* **How It Operates:** SAMRIDH partners with established startup accelerators. It matches capital with accelerator mentorship, customer discovery, go-to-market strategies, and investor networks.
* **Financial Assistance:** Offers up to **₹40 Lakh** in seed/growth funding per startup based on milestone achievements, alongside matching investment models where private accelerator capital is paired with government funding.
* **Eligibility:** Product-stage startups with an operational Minimum Viable Product (MVP) and proof of initial market validation in tech domains (FinTech, HealthTech, EdTech, AgriTech, Enterprise Tech).

5. BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)

Administered by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), a Public Sector Enterprise under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), BIG is India's premier early-stage grant for life sciences and bio-entrepreneurs.

* **How It Operates:** Recognizing the long gestation periods and high lab infrastructure costs of biotech, BIRAC provides non-dilutive grant-in-aid to turn academic research or lab concepts into commercially viable technologies.
* **Financial Assistance:** Up to **₹50 Lakh** in pure grant-in-aid for up to 18 months, requiring zero equity dilution.
* **Eligibility:** Early-stage biotech startups (incorporated under 5 years) or individual researchers with a clear commercialization roadmap in healthcare, diagnostics, industrial biotech, medical devices, or agriculture.

### Key Action Step: Getting DPIIT Recognition

Most central schemes require formal recognition by DPIIT. To take advantage of these initiatives, founders should ensure their entity is registered as a Private Limited Company, LLP, or Registered Partnership, under 10 years old, with an annual turnover under ₹100 Crore. Applications can be completed online via the **Startup India Portal** (https://t.co/6CE57aaQPu) with basic incorporation documents and a clear note explaining innovation and scalability.

This is my testimony I gave almost 2 years ago. Everything has just gotten better. Sorry it’s so long. 1/2

I grew up in a strong LDS family here in Utah, surrounded by the church’s teachings. My ancestors were pioneers who settled here, and I was raised to believe that being holy, righteous, and perfect was the way to God. But I never felt perfect. I never felt holy. I didn’t have a testimony of God—because I thought it was all about my own effort to get to Heaven, my own righteousness. That pressure left me feeling unworthy for Gods love.

I was planning to go on an LDS mission, not for God or myself, but to make my parents happy. That plan got shattered when I was 15. Out of nowhere, my dad went to Scotland for two weeks. We thought it was a midlife crisis, but it’s that he was chasing a second wife, wanting to live like Joseph Smith with polygamy and the “original” church. My mom wasn’t having it. She hired a tough divorce attorney, and their marriage ended. My mom married that attorney, and my dad married the woman from Scotland, who used him and didn’t share his values. Their marriage lasted less than two years.

By my junior year of high school, I was 16 and alone in our big, empty house. My siblings had moved out, my mom lived with her new husband, and my dad with his new wife and they were all in another city. I felt abandoned. I saw what “religion” did to my family, and I wanted nothing to do with it. But deep down, my heart told me there was a God—I just didn’t want that one that helped break up my family.

With no supervision, I turned to my friends for stability. We started experimenting with alcohol and drugs. My house became the party spot, and I partied the hardest because I hurt the most. Drugs became my rock, my idol, my escape. By the end of high school, many of my friends went on LDS missions——most are now agnostic or atheist now—and I kept chasing the high. I was an addict, moving from one drug to another, believing in a god but not knowing who He was. My god was the world.

Years later, At 20, my sister caught me using drugs in our house that we had together. She told our dad. He showed up at my workplace and asked, “What are you doing with your life?” That question hit hard. He offered to pay for rehab, one chance, and I took it seriously. I went to all the meetings, changed my friends, and turned my life around—not for God, but to please my Dad. For the first time, I got to know him. I got to live with him  for nearly two years, me on an air mattress, him on a cot. He was cool, funny, awesome. I finally had a relationship with my father.

But in 2009, everything changed, again. My sister came to my dad’s condo one morning, tears in her eyes, and told me my dad had just taken his own life. The man I’d just seen hours before was gone. My rock, my stability, were gone. I felt abandoned again. I lost all hope, bought a bunch of pills, and did them all for a few days, not caring if I lived or died. I survived, obviously and somehow, I turned away from drugs for good. Looking back, I believe God was protecting me, even when I didn’t know Him. 
He was my true rock—I just didn’t know it yet.

That same year, I started dating a woman with a two-year-old son. I wanted a family, so I poured myself into that relationship. After nine years, I proposed, adopted her son, Spencer, Hes now an amazing 16-year-old. But our marriage didn’t last. We didn’t have God in our relationship—no Bible, no faith. We divorced in 2022. 

I still believed in a creator, but I thought I wasn’t worthy of the LDS god I’d grown up with, so I didn’t try.

text:
🐶💔 THE SADDEST THING ABOUT LOVING A DOG IS THAT WE OFTEN DON'T REALIZE WE'RE LIVING THROUGH THE MOMENTS WE'LL ONE DAY WISH WE COULD HAVE BACK.

That ordinary morning when your dog followed you into the kitchen.

That ridiculous bark when someone knocked on the door.

That little nose pushing against your hand.

That familiar sound of paws following you down the hallway.

That worn-out toy dropped beside your feet.

That happy face waiting for you after a long, exhausting day.

Right now, these things might seem so ordinary that you barely notice them.

But here's something I want you to think about.

WHAT IF THE MOMENTS YOU KEEP RUSHING THROUGH ARE THE VERY MOMENTS THAT MAKE YOUR LIFE BEAUTIFUL?

What if the happiest memories aren't waiting for you in some distant future?

What if they're already happening?

In your living room.

In your garden.

On your morning walk.

Beside your bed.

Or curled up on the sofa, covered in fur, dreaming about something only a dog could understand.

❤️ BEFORE YOU SCROLL, PLEASE DO THREE THINGS.

❤️ LIKE if a dog has ever brought happiness into your life when you needed it most.

💬 COMMENT YOUR DOG'S NAME. I want to fill this post with the names of dogs who make ordinary lives extraordinary.

🔁 SHARE THIS WITH SOMEONE WHO LOVES THEIR DOG. Because somewhere tonight, someone might read these words, put down their phone, and spend a few precious minutes with their best friend.

And those few minutes?

They may become a memory that lasts a lifetime.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

❤️ YOUR DOG HAS SEEN A VERSION OF YOU THAT MOST PEOPLE NEVER WILL.

Think about it.

Your colleagues see the professional version of you.

Your friends see the version that laughs, jokes, and socializes.

Your neighbours see the person who smiles politely while collecting the rubbish bins.

Social media sees the moments you choose to share.

But your dog?

Your dog sees everything in between.

The exhausted version of you.

The version that comes home after a difficult day and doesn't feel like talking.

The version that sits quietly on the sofa, thinking about bills, responsibilities, and problems nobody else knows about.

The version that dances terribly in the kitchen.

The version that talks to themselves.

The version that opens the refrigerator three times, hoping something delicious has magically appeared since the last inspection.

😂🐶

Your dog knows your ordinary life.

The unfiltered version.

No expensive clothes required.

No impressive job title.

No carefully chosen photographs.

No pretending that everything is perfect.

And somehow...

THAT'S THE PERSON THEY'RE SO HAPPY TO SEE.

They don't need you to be famous.

They don't need you to earn six figures.

They don't need you to have thousands of followers.

They don't need you to impress the world.

They know your voice.

Your footsteps.

Your routines.

The way you say their name.

The way you scratch behind their ears.

And the comfort of being near someone they trust.

YOU SPEND SO MUCH OF YOUR LIFE TRYING TO BECOME SOMEONE IMPORTANT TO THE WORLD…

WHILE TO YOUR DOG, YOU MAY ALREADY BE THE MOST IMPORTANT PERSON IN THE ROOM. ❤️

Read that again.

And if your dog has ever made you feel loved without needing to accomplish anything first, leave a ❤️ in the comments.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🏠 THERE IS A CELEBRATION HAPPENING IN YOUR HOUSE THAT YOU MAY HAVE STOPPED APPRECIATING.

Imagine this.

It's been a terrible day.

Your boss was difficult.

Your phone wouldn't stop ringing.

Traffic was unbearable.

You have bills to pay.

Emails to answer.

Problems waiting for tomorrow.

You're exhausted.

You pull into your driveway.

Turn off the engine.

Sit quietly for a moment.

Then open the front door.

And suddenly…

🐶 ABSOLUTE CHAOS!

The tail starts wagging.

Then the entire body joins in.

Your dog begins spinning around like a furry helicopter that's completely lost control of its navigation system.

😂😂

They grab a toy.

Drop it.

Pick it up.

Run toward you.

Run away.

Come back.

Make a noise that sounds like a mixture of a squeaky door and an excited dinosaur.

And why?

Because you came home.

That's it.

You didn't win an award.

You didn't receive a promotion.

You didn't become famous.

You didn't achieve something extraordinary.

YOU SIMPLY WALKED THROUGH THE DOOR.

And somebody thought that was worth celebrating.

Think about that.

In a world where we're constantly being told to achieve more, earn more, and become more…

There may be a little creature in your home who is simply delighted that you're there.

❤️ IMAGINE BEING SO IMPORTANT TO SOMEONE THAT YOUR ARRIVAL TURNS AN ORDINARY EVENING INTO A CELEBRATION.

Now answer honestly.

When was the last time you stopped long enough to appreciate that welcome?

💬 If your dog greets you as though you've returned from a ten-year expedition every time you leave the house, comment:

"THAT'S MY DOG! 😂🐾"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎾 LET ME TELL YOU A STORY ABOUT A MAN, HIS DOG, AND A TENNIS BALL HE ALMOST THREW AWAY.

His name was Daniel.

He was 43 years old.

He worked long hours.

He had a family to support.

Bills to pay.

Responsibilities.

Deadlines.

And a golden retriever named Charlie.

Charlie had three great loves.

Food.

Daniel.

And a filthy green tennis ball.

Not necessarily in that order.

😂🐶

That tennis ball was disgusting.

It was old.

Half destroyed.

Covered in dirt.

It had survived hundreds of games of fetch, countless muddy adventures, and several unsuccessful attempts by Daniel to throw it in the bin.

But Charlie always found it.

To Daniel, it was rubbish.

To Charlie?

IT WAS THE GREATEST INVENTION IN HUMAN HISTORY.

Every evening, Daniel came home.

He ate dinner.

Opened his laptop.

Checked his emails.

Answered messages.

And tried to finish the work he'd brought home.

Charlie had a different schedule.

6:30 PM — Locate tennis ball.

6:31 PM — Deliver tennis ball to human.

6:32 PM — Wait for human to understand the importance of the situation.

😂🐾

Charlie would approach Daniel.

Ball in mouth.

Tail wagging.

And…

DROP.

Daniel would glance down.

"Not now, buddy."

Charlie would wait.

Then pick up the ball.

Walk away.

Return thirty seconds later.

DROP.

"Charlie, I'm busy."

Another thirty seconds.

DROP.

😂

Sometimes Daniel laughed.

Sometimes he played.

Sometimes he became irritated.

"CHARLIE! GIVE ME FIVE MINUTES!"

But Charlie kept returning.

Because in Charlie's world, the tennis ball wasn't simply something to chase.

It was a way to spend time with his favourite person.

And for years…

That was their routine.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💔 THEN ONE EVENING, SOMETHING HAPPENED THAT MADE DANIEL LOOK AT THAT TENNIS BALL DIFFERENTLY.

Charlie walked into the room.

The same green ball in his mouth.

But this time, he moved slowly.

His face had become grey.

His steps were gentler.

The puppy who once raced through the house like a tornado had become an older dog.

Daniel hadn't noticed exactly when it happened.

There was no announcement.

No dramatic moment.

No warning.

Just the quiet passage of time.

He remembered the day he'd brought Charlie home.

A tiny golden puppy.

Oversized paws.

Floppy ears.

A tail that never stopped moving.

He remembered Charlie's first walk.

His first game of fetch.

His first swim.

The time he'd stolen an entire sandwich from the kitchen counter.

The day he'd proudly carried one of Daniel's shoes into the garden and buried it.

😂🐶

He remembered shouting:

"CHARLIE! SLOW DOWN!"

"CHARLIE! STOP RUNNING!"

"CHARLIE! COME BACK!"

And now…

Charlie had slowed down.

Not because Daniel had asked him to.

But because the years had passed.

Daniel looked at his dog.

Then at the laptop.

Then at the old tennis ball.

And a thought entered his mind.

"HOW MANY TIMES HAVE I TOLD HIM 'LATER'?"

Not because Daniel didn't love Charlie.

He did.

He fed him.

Walked him.

Cared for him.

Made sure he was safe.

But somewhere between work, responsibilities, and everyday life, Daniel had started treating those little invitations to play as interruptions.

And suddenly he understood something.

CHARLIE WASN'T INTERRUPTING HIS LIFE.

CHARLIE WAS PART OF THE LIFE HE WAS WORKING SO HARD TO BUILD.

That realization stayed with him.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎾 THEN CAME THE EVENING DANIEL DECIDED THAT THE EMAIL COULD WAIT.

It was a Thursday.

Daniel was sitting at his desk.

Laptop open.

Phone beside him.

A hundred things still to do.

Charlie entered the room.

Slowly.

Carrying that familiar green ball.

He walked toward Daniel.

Stopped.

And dropped it.

THUMP.

Daniel barely looked up.

"Not now, Charlie."

But something made him pause.

He turned.

Charlie was standing there.

Grey muzzle.

Gentle eyes.

Tail moving slowly.

Waiting.

Daniel looked at his laptop.

Then at Charlie.

And asked himself:

"FIVE YEARS FROM NOW, WILL I REMEMBER THIS EMAIL?"

Probably not.

But would he remember an evening spent laughing with Charlie?

A few minutes playing in the garden?

Sitting beside him in the grass?

Watching his old friend proudly carry that ridiculous ball?

Those were the moments worth making room for.

Daniel closed the laptop.

Put his phone aside.

Picked up the ball.

And smiled.

❤️🐾 "COME ON, OLD BOY. LET'S GO."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌅 WHAT HAPPENED NEXT WAS NOTHING EXTRAORDINARY. AND THAT'S WHAT MADE IT BEAUTIFUL.

They went into the garden.

Daniel threw the ball.

Charlie followed.

Not particularly quickly.

Not particularly gracefully.

But happily.

He picked it up.

Brought it back.

Dropped it.

Daniel threw it again.

And again.

After a while, Charlie became tired.

He lay down in the grass.

The green ball resting between his paws.

Daniel sat beside him.

The evening was quiet.

No cameras.

No beautiful music.

No spectacular sunset.

No audience.

No viral moment.

Just a man sitting beside his dog.

Daniel gently scratched Charlie behind the ears.

Charlie rested his head against Daniel's leg.

And for the first time in weeks…

Daniel wasn't thinking about tomorrow.

He wasn't worrying about work.

He wasn't checking his phone.

He wasn't replaying the problems of the day.

He was simply there.

With Charlie.

And for that moment…

That was enough.

SOMETIMES THE MOST BEAUTIFUL MOMENTS OF OUR LIVES ARE THE ONES WE NEVER THINK TO PHOTOGRAPH. ❤️

And sometimes the most valuable thing we can give someone we love isn't money.

It isn't a gift.

It isn't something expensive.

It's our undivided attention.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⏳ HERE'S SOMETHING ABOUT TIME THAT EVERY DOG OWNER EVENTUALLY UNDERSTANDS.

We measure our lives in years.

We make five-year plans.

Ten-year plans.

Retirement plans.

We tell ourselves:

"I'll relax when work becomes easier."

"I'll spend more time at home when I earn more."

"I'll take that holiday next year."

"I'll enjoy life when everything settles down."

But dogs move through life on a different timeline.

The puppy who once couldn't climb onto the sofa…

Eventually becomes the dog who occupies 90% of it.

😂🐶

The young dog who raced through the garden like a furry tornado…

Eventually begins enjoying slower walks.

The face that once seemed impossibly young…

Gradually develops little patches of grey.

And the paws that once raced across the floor…

May begin moving more carefully.

This isn't a reason to spend every day feeling sad.

It's a reason to appreciate the beautiful chapter you're living right now.

Because every age has something special.

Puppies bring curiosity.

Young dogs bring adventure.

Adult dogs bring familiar routines.

Older dogs often bring a quieter kind of companionship.

And every stage deserves to be loved.

❤️ DON'T SPEND SO MUCH TIME MISSING THE PUPPY YOUR DOG USED TO BE THAT YOU FORGET TO LOVE THE DOG THEY ARE TODAY.

The slower walks matter.

The longer naps matter.

The quiet evenings matter.

The gentle affection matters.

And the old tennis ball?

That still matters too.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐶 NOW THINK ABOUT YOUR OWN DOG.

Not dogs in general.

YOUR dog.

The one with the strange habits.

The ridiculous personality.

The unmistakable bark.

The favourite sleeping position.

The one who somehow convinced you that your bed belongs to them.

😂

Think about the little things.

The way they tilt their head when you speak.

The way they follow you into the bathroom.

Because apparently, in your dog's opinion, human beings cannot be trusted to complete this activity without supervision.

😂🐶

The way they develop superhuman hearing when you open a packet of cheese.

The way they sleep through the television, the vacuum cleaner, and the doorbell…

But wake instantly when someone whispers:

"Chicken."

The way they stare at you while you're eating.

As though they're a starving Victorian orphan who hasn't received a meal since 1843.

Despite eating seventeen minutes ago.

😂😂

The way they steal your warm spot on the sofa.

The way they carry the same toy everywhere.

The way they sigh dramatically when you ask them to move.

The way they rest their head on your knee.

The way they look at you when you say their name.

These things might occasionally test your patience.

But they're also what makes your dog uniquely yours.

THERE ARE MILLIONS OF DOGS IN THE WORLD.

BUT THERE IS ONLY ONE WHO DOES THAT PARTICULAR RIDICULOUS THING IN YOUR HOUSE.

And I guarantee you know exactly what I'm talking about.

👇 Tell me in the comments:

WHAT IS THE FUNNIEST OR STRANGEST THING YOUR DOG DOES?

Let's see how many dog owners recognize their own furry troublemaker in someone else's story.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🏡 SOMETIMES THE THINGS WE COMPLAIN ABOUT TODAY ARE THE VERY THINGS WE MAY ONE DAY REMEMBER WITH THE MOST AFFECTION.

The fur on your sofa.

The muddy paw prints.

The toys scattered across the living room.

The nose marks on the window.

The leash hanging beside the door.

The blanket that somehow belongs entirely to your dog.

😂🐶

Yes, it's a mess.

Yes, it needs cleaning.

And yes, your vacuum cleaner probably deserves a medal for outstanding service.

But think about what those little things represent.

The toys mean someone has been playing.

The blanket means someone has been resting.

The leash represents walks.

Fresh air.

New smells.

Shared adventures.

The paw prints might be evidence of a wonderful afternoon outside.

And the dog hair on your black trousers?

Well…

That might simply mean your Labrador has appointed themselves your personal fashion designer.

😂❤️

SOMETIMES THE LITTLE THINGS THAT MAKE OUR HOMES IMPERFECT ARE ALSO THE THINGS THAT MAKE THEM FEEL ALIVE.

And perhaps that's worth remembering the next time you find another tennis ball under the sofa.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💔 IF YOU'VE EVER LOVED A DOG WHO IS NO LONGER HERE, THIS PART IS FOR YOU.

Sometimes the memories that return aren't the big ones.

They're the little things.

The sound of paws on the floor.

The way your dog waited near the kitchen.

Their favourite place to sleep.

The way they greeted you.

The strange noises they made.

The toy they carried everywhere.

The particular look they gave you when they wanted something.

Sometimes you find an old photograph.

Or see a dog that looks like them.

Or hear a familiar bark.

And suddenly…

A memory returns.

Maybe you smile.

Maybe you cry.

Maybe both.

Because grief and gratitude can exist together.

You can miss a dog deeply and still feel thankful for the years you shared.

You can remember the difficult goodbye while also remembering the thousands of beautiful moments that came before it.

And you can carry that love with you.

A DOG DOESN'T HAVE TO BE BESIDE YOU TODAY FOR THE LOVE YOU SHARED TO REMAIN PART OF YOUR LIFE. ❤️

If you've loved a dog who has passed away, you're welcome to share their name below.

Write:

🐾 "FOREVER LOVED — [YOUR DOG'S NAME]."

And perhaps share one beautiful memory.

Not because you have to explain your grief.

But because their story matters.

And if you see someone remembering a dog they've lost, please leave them a kind reply.

Sometimes a few gentle words can mean more than we realize.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

❤️ BUT PLEASE DON'T WAIT FOR A MEMORY TO BECOME PRECIOUS BEFORE YOU APPRECIATE IT.

If your dog is still beside you, enjoy the chapter you're living.

The familiar greetings.

The walks.

The games.

The quiet evenings.

The funny habits.

The little moments of companionship.

You don't need to spend every minute together.

You have work.

Family.

Responsibilities.

Difficult days.

Days when you're exhausted.

Days when you need rest.

That's part of being human.

And loving your dog doesn't mean becoming a perfect owner who never gets tired or busy.

It means caring.

Learning.

Being patient.

Providing what they need.

And making space for your relationship.

Sometimes that means a long walk.

Sometimes it means a short game.

Sometimes it means a little training.

Sometimes it means letting your dog explore interesting smells.

And sometimes it simply means sitting quietly together.

LOVE DOESN'T ALWAYS REQUIRE SOMETHING EXTRAORDINARY.

Sometimes it just requires being present.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐾 HERE'S SOMETHING I WISH EVERY DOG OWNER REMEMBERED.

Your dog doesn't need expensive toys every week.

They don't need constant entertainment.

They don't need every day to be an adventure.

But they do need care.

Safety.

Appropriate exercise.

Rest.

Good nutrition.

Veterinary attention.

Mental stimulation.

Patience.

And opportunities to enjoy being a dog.

A walk isn't always just about covering distance.

For your dog, sniffing can be a wonderful form of enrichment.

You see a lamppost.

Your dog sees the neighbourhood's entire social media feed.

😂🐶

"Interesting. Max was here."

"Apparently Bella passed through."

"Wait a minute…"

"WHO IS THIS NEW DOG?!"

😂

When it's safe, let them explore.

Let them sniff.

Let them enjoy the world through their extraordinary senses.

Learn their personality.

Respect their boundaries.

Notice when they want affection and when they prefer space.

Because loving a dog isn't just about how much happiness they bring into our lives.

It's also about helping them live happy, healthy, fulfilling lives of their own.

❤️ THE BEST RELATIONSHIPS AREN'T ONLY ABOUT BEING LOVED. THEY'RE ALSO ABOUT LOVING WELL.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌙 TONIGHT, I WANT YOU TO TRY SOMETHING DIFFERENT.

When the day becomes quiet…

Put your phone down for a few minutes.

Find your dog.

Maybe they're sleeping on the sofa.

Maybe they're resting at your feet.

Maybe they're watching you with intense suspicion because you've just opened a packet of biscuits without offering them one.

😂🐶

If they're sleeping peacefully, let them rest.

If they're awake and interested, offer a little attention.

Say their name.

Notice their expression.

Maybe their ears move.

Maybe their tail wags.

Maybe they wander over.

Maybe they bring you a toy.

Or maybe they simply enjoy sitting nearby.

Whatever happens…

Appreciate the moment.

The familiar room.

The familiar face.

The little sounds.

The quiet companionship.

Because this is your life.

Not the life you're planning for five years from now.

Not the life you wish you had yesterday.

THIS ONE.

This evening.

This home.

This dog.

This ordinary moment.

And there's something beautiful about realizing that you don't have to wait for a special occasion to appreciate what you already have.

❤️ SOME OF THE BEST THINGS IN LIFE AREN'T THINGS WE'RE STILL WAITING FOR.

THEY'RE ALREADY HERE.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💌 NOW IMAGINE YOUR DOG COULD WRITE YOU A LETTER.

Not a complicated letter.

Not a list of everything 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

❤️ NOW I WANT EVERY DOG LOVER READING THIS TO ANSWER ONE QUESTION.

WHAT IS ONE LITTLE THING YOUR DOG DOES THAT YOU HOPE YOU NEVER FORGET?

Not the expensive toys.

Not the perfect photographs.

Not the fancy accessories.

The little things.

Maybe it's the way they rest their head on your knee.

The way they greet you when you return.

The way they carry their favourite toy everywhere.

The way they insist on sleeping beside you.

The way they tilt their head when you speak.

The way they gently place a paw on your arm.

The way they make you laugh when nothing else seems funny.

Or maybe it's something so strange and ridiculous that nobody outside your family would understand.

😂❤️

I WANT TO HEAR THAT STORY.

👇 TELL ME THREE THINGS IN THE COMMENTS:

🐾 1. YOUR DOG'S NAME.

🐾 2. THEIR BREED OR MIX.

🐾 3. THE ONE LITTLE HABIT THAT MAKES THEM IMPOSSIBLE NOT TO LOVE.

And if your dog has passed away, you're welcome to share their name and a favourite memory too.

Because love doesn't become less meaningful when it becomes a memory.

Every dog has a story.

Every dog has a personality.

And every dog deserves to be remembered for the wonderful, funny, unique individual they are.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔁 AND PLEASE, SHARE THIS POST WITH SOMEONE WHO LOVES THEIR DOG.

Share it with the person whose phone is filled with dog photographs.

Share it with the friend who talks to their dog as though they're a human being.

Share it with the person whose dog has taken over the sofa.

Share it with someone caring for an older dog.

Share it with someone who recently welcomed a puppy.

Share it with someone who has been having a difficult week.

And share it with someone who might need a gentle reminder to appreciate the companionship already in their life.

Because this isn't about making anyone feel guilty.

It's about helping people notice something beautiful.

Something simple.

Something easy to overlook.

text:
BFCM is 7 weeks away and EVERY brand in your niche is about to run the same EXACT play:

“20% off on every product” and call it a day.

Not you though. Because you’re about to read the sauciest masterclass on BFCM offers, positioning, and funnel engineering you’ve ever seen…

All grounded in the 5-step copy/paste protocol we use to extract $1M+ out of every Q4 and dominate competition:

(Save and implement ALL of this. Google Ads edition)

Step 1: understand why the "20% off" play dies

Every market gets louder over time.

First, a simple claim wins. Then competitors copy you and a bigger claim wins. Then buyers stop believing bigger claims, so a new mechanism wins. And once buyers have heard every claim, the brand they recognise themselves in wins.

During BFCM, every market hits the last stage on discounts in 4 days flat.

"20% off" sits next to "25% off" sits next to "30% off", and the buyer stops reading the numbers.

So you win in 2 ways:

- Change the mechanism of the offer, so your deal looks different from everyone else's

- Write copy for the specific buyer behind each search, so he sees himself in your ad

Shouting a bigger percentage only drags you into a race to zero margin.

The market is too sophisticated for that.

Step 2: pick offers built for Q4

1. The tiered threshold

Spend $100, save 20% | $200, save 30% | $300, save 40%

Buyers hunt for one small add-on to reach the next tier, so the same expensive click brings home a bigger order.

But model every tier first. Say every product sells for $60 and costs you $24 all in:

- 2 items ($120) at 20% off: $96 revenue, $48 profit

- 4 items ($240) at 30% off: $168 revenue, $72 profit

- 5 items ($300) at 40% off: $180 revenue, $60 profit

The top tier makes MORE revenue and LESS profit than the tier below. You'd be paying customers to spend more.

Every tier has to earn more profit per order than the one below, or the tier goes. Drop the top tier to 35% off and you get $195 revenue and $75 profit.

Point being: sort out the math so that you don't scroll your margins over.

2. The gift set

A pre-built bundle at one flat price, boxed and ready to give.

One curated set converts better than asking a buyer to build his own cart, because the only decision left is "yes".

Upload the set as its own product in Merchant Center, with its own title ("Sleep Gift Set, Magnesium + Sleep Mask + Tea"), and Shopping shows the set for gift searches your single products never touch.

3. The mystery gift threshold

Free $50 full-size mystery product on every order over $120.

On high-margin products, the gift costs you around $9 to make. A 20% discount on the same order costs $24. The buyer pays full price, you keep $15 more per order, and your brand never looks cheap.

4. The early-access list

"Get our Black Friday deal 24 hours before everyone else."

Run this through YouTube and Demand Gen in October, while CPMs are still sane. Every sign-up buys on launch day from an email or a text, at zero click cost, before your competitors' sales even start.

5. The subscribe-first offer (supplements, skincare, coffee, anything people reorder)

Give the deepest BFCM discount on the first subscription order, and a smaller one on single purchases.

A one-off BFCM buyer is worth one order. A subscriber you acquire at peak CPCs keeps paying you through Q1.

6. The gift card bonus

Buy a $100 gift card, get a $25 bonus card to spend in January.

You bank the cash in November and pull the buyer back in your slowest month of the year.

7. The friction killers

Free gift wrapping. Extended returns until January 31. Delivery date shown on the product page.

None of these touch your margin much, and every one of them answers the question stopping a gift buyer from checking out.

Step 3: position the offer with stronger angles than "X% off"

- The framing trick: if the offer is below $100 and you're running a discount, just show the discount. Saying 33% off sounds more impressive than telling them they're saving $3. If it's above $100, slash the price and focus on the price "before and after". Telling someone they're paying $100 for a $200 product sounds crazier than a 50% discount

- The deadline: "Prices go back up Monday at midnight." Giving clear deadlines with logic behind it increase impulse buys without triggering any brand trust issues. Just make sure you actually raise them at midnight.

- The delivery promise: "Free Delivery Before Christmas". One of the biggest objections during BFCM is "will this arrive by time of sending it as a Christmas gift?" Only promise the date your 3PL confirmed in writing though

- The identification angle: "For the runner who already owns everything." Selling them on an idendity is a good cheeky play to run if your branding is strong

- The sell-out angle: "Sold out in 6 hours last year." Only if true, and only with the stock to back the claim up

- The only-sale-of-the-year angle: if your brand never discounts, tell people. "Our one sale of 2026" outsells "30% off" from a brand on sale every other week

Step 4: engineer the funnels winning Q4

Do not just run a generic product page for every click. 

Every buyer arrives at a different stage, from never having heard of you to typing your brand name with a card in hand, and each stage needs its own funnel:

1. The early-access funnel (top of funnel, October)

YouTube and Demand Gen ads (Google's Meta) for a problem or a gift idea, to a page with one job: collect the email and phone number for the 24-hour early access.

You build a warm list and a remarketing pool while everyone else is still asleep.

2. The advertorial funnel (top of funnel, cold YouTube traffic)

A problem-led video ad, to an advertorial ("Why your 3am wake-ups get worse in winter"), to the offer page with the tier ladder.

Couple this with the "bundle offer" we talked about such as a sleep mask, nose strip, magnesium glycinate, and melatonin, and you got yourself an instant winner.

3. The gift-finder quiz (middle of funnel, gift searches)

"gifts for runners", "christmas gifts under $50", "gift for him", straight to a quiz: who's the gift for, what's the budget, what are they into.

Every result ends on a gift set with wrapping, a gift note and a delivery date. Gift search traffic is huge in Q4 and almost every brand dumps the traffic on a homepage.

4. The listicle funnel (middle of funnel, category and problem searches)

"magnesium for sleep black friday", "why do i wake up at 3am", to a listicle ("7 sleep supplements worth buying this Black Friday") with your product at number 2 (to not make it too obvious) and the deal stacked underneath.

5. The comparison funnel (bottom of funnel, competitor searches)

"[competitor] black friday", "[brand] vs [competitor]", to a comparison page with both deals side by side, yours winning on total value (price, gift, shipping, returns, guarantee).

Just make sure it's true and let your competitor win in a category or 2, but make those be categories that your ICP doesn't care about (e.g. if you're selling a premium product, frame the other as a cheaper "low cost" alternative for casuals).

Competitors attack your name hardest during BFCM. This is how you take theirs back.

6. The offer page (bottom of funnel, brand searches)

"[brand] black friday", "[brand] discount code", to a page with the code, the tier ladder and the countdown ABOVE the fold.

Skip the story. These buyers already believe you.

7. The post-purchase upsell (after checkout)

One-click add-on after the order goes through. "Add a second gift set for $39."

Your order value climbs and you pay zero for an extra click.

Step 5: load everything into Google before the review queues jam

- Sale prices in Merchant Center, so Shopping shows the strikethrough

- Merchant Promotions, so your listings carry the "Special offer" tag

- Promotion assets on every Search campaign, plus one sitelink per tier ("Spend $200, Save 30%")

- 3 cuts of every hero YouTube ad: cold (problem first, offer last), remarketing (offer in the first 5 seconds), Cyber Monday (self-gift)

- Every ad, promotion and page uploaded at least a week early

The brands winning Q4 on Google rarely have the biggest discount.

They have an offer nobody else is running, and a funnel waiting for every buyer who shows up.

- Max

(If you want us to build your Q4 Google and YouTube Ads before the November rush, DM me "GADS" and I'll show you what I'd launch first)

text:
🚨💰 THE INTERNET HAS CREATED A STRANGE KIND OF MILLIONAIRE: SOMEONE WITH A MILLION FOLLOWERS WHO CAN'T AFFORD TO PAY THEIR BILLS.

Read that again.

Imagine being recognized everywhere you go.

People ask for photographs.

Your videos attract millions of views.

Your posts receive thousands of likes.

Strangers call you successful.

Your friends envy your lifestyle.

Your followers believe you're living the dream.

But tonight?

You're sitting alone, staring at your banking app, wondering how you're going to pay next month's rent.

Now imagine someone else.

They have just 3,000 followers.

Nobody recognizes them in public.

Their videos rarely exceed 500 views.

Some posts receive only 12 likes.

But every month...

💳 Customers are purchasing.

🤝 Clients are renewing contracts.

📧 Business inquiries are arriving.

🏦 Bills are being paid.

👨👩👧👦 Their family is financially supported.

📈 Their business is steadily growing.

NOW ANSWER THIS QUESTION: WHICH PERSON WOULD YOU RATHER BE?

Because we've reached a point where people are spending years trying to LOOK successful online while overlooking the things that could make them financially successful in real life.

And I believe this is one of the biggest traps in the creator economy.

❤️ LIKE THIS POST if you'd rather have financial freedom than internet fame.

💬 COMMENT "FAME" or "FREEDOM" before you continue reading.

🔁 SHARE THIS POST because someone with only 200 followers might desperately need this message today.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 LET ME OFFER YOU SOMETHING THAT SOUNDS TOO GOOD TO BE TRUE.

Tomorrow morning, you wake up to a message.

"CONGRATULATIONS! YOU'VE BEEN SELECTED TO RECEIVE ONE OF TWO SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS."

Both accounts are completely free.

Both are legitimate.

You can choose either one.

But there's one condition.

YOU CANNOT HAVE BOTH.

📱 ACCOUNT A: THE INTERNET CELEBRITY

👥 500,000 followers.

👀 10 million monthly views.

❤️ Thousands of likes.

💬 Hundreds of comments.

🔥 Videos regularly going viral.

🌍 Recognition wherever you go.

People admire you.

Brands occasionally contact you.

Your friends tell everyone they know you.

Every time you upload, your phone lights up.

But behind the beautiful numbers?

Your income is inconsistent.

Your bills are piling up.

You have no reliable customer base.

You're constantly worried about the next algorithm change.

You feel pressured to create content every single day.

And when a video performs badly, your confidence collapses.

You have attention.

You have popularity.

You have recognition.

BUT YOU DON'T HAVE FINANCIAL SECURITY.

Now let's examine your second option.

💰 ACCOUNT B: THE UNKNOWN BUSINESS OWNER

👥 5,000 followers.

👀 700 views per post.

❤️ 20–40 likes.

💬 Five comments on a good day.

📱 Nobody recognizes you in the supermarket.

Your friends don't consider you famous.

Your content doesn't regularly go viral.

But…

💳 Customers buy your products.

🤝 Businesses pay for your services.

🔁 Existing customers return.

⭐ Happy clients recommend you.

📧 Your inbox contains genuine business inquiries.

🏦 Your business earns more than it spends.

❤️ You have greater financial stability.

You don't need strangers applauding you.

You don't need millions of views.

You don't need to become famous.

YOU HAVE BUILT SOMETHING THAT CAN GENERATE INCOME EVEN WHEN YOUR CONTENT DOESN'T GO VIRAL.

Now be completely truthful.

👇 WOULD YOU CHOOSE A OR B?

And don't just give me a letter.

Tell me WHY.

I want to see how many people genuinely value financial independence over social media popularity.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💔 NOW LET ME TELL YOU ABOUT THE THREE YEARS YOU CAN NEVER GET BACK.

Imagine someone starting a social media account.

They're excited.

They're ambitious.

They dream of becoming successful.

They tell themselves:

"When I reach 10,000 followers, everything will change."

So they begin.

Every morning, they check their numbers.

Every evening, they edit videos.

Every weekend, they study the algorithm.

They buy courses.

They purchase equipment.

They experiment with hashtags.

They copy trending formats.

They sacrifice sleep.

They miss family time.

They work harder than many people realize.

Six months pass.

Then one year.

Then two.

Finally, after three years…

THEY REACH 100,000 FOLLOWERS!

🎉 Congratulations flood the comments.

🔥 Their friends celebrate.

❤️ Their audience congratulates them.

For a moment, everything feels worthwhile.

But later that night…

They sit down to calculate their finances.

And something painful becomes clear.

They have spent three years learning how to attract attention.

But almost no time learning how to attract paying customers.

They have mastered engagement.

But not sales.

They have built visibility.

But not a sustainable business.

They know how to get strangers to watch.

But not how to solve a problem someone will pay to have solved.

And suddenly, 100,000 followers doesn't feel quite as impressive.

BECAUSE YOU CANNOT PAY YOUR ELECTRICITY BILL WITH LIKES.

You cannot automatically pay your rent with comments.

And a viral video doesn't guarantee financial freedom.

This doesn't mean building an audience was worthless.

It means attention needs a purpose.

🚨 POPULARITY IS NOT A BUSINESS MODEL. IT IS AN OPPORTUNITY TO BUILD ONE.

❤️ Like this if that distinction makes sense.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

☕ TWO COFFEE SHOPS. ONE STREET. TWO VERY DIFFERENT FUTURES.

Imagine two friends opening coffee shops in the same neighborhood.

Let's call them David and Michael.

David spends heavily on social media marketing.

He hires influencers.

He creates spectacular videos.

His shop becomes an online sensation.

One video reaches two million people.

Everyone talks about it.

His Instagram account reaches 80,000 followers.

But there's a problem.

Many viewers live hundreds of miles away.

Some are in completely different countries.

Others simply enjoy watching his content.

They aren't necessarily interested in buying coffee from him.

Meanwhile, rent is due.

Employees need salaries.

Suppliers need payment.

His business struggles.

Now consider Michael.

His coffee shop has only 900 Instagram followers.

His videos rarely exceed 300 views.

Nobody has called him an influencer.

But every morning…

A teacher buys her usual cappuccino.

A construction worker orders breakfast.

Three office employees stop for coffee.

A customer recommends the shop to a colleague.

A nearby company places a catering order.

His customers know him.

They trust his service.

They return.

They recommend him.

And his business makes a healthy profit.

DAVID HAS MORE ATTENTION. MICHAEL HAS MORE PAYING CUSTOMERS.

Which coffee shop would you rather own?

👇 Comment "DAVID" or "MICHAEL."

Because this example reveals something important:

👀 Views can create awareness.

❤️ Likes can indicate interest.

💬 Comments can start conversations.

🤝 Trust can create relationships.

💳 Sales generate revenue.

🏦 Profit helps keep a business alive.

AND CONFUSING THESE THINGS CAN BE AN EXPENSIVE MISTAKE.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 NOW HERE'S SOMETHING THAT MIGHT COMPLETELY CHANGE HOW YOU THINK ABOUT YOUR FOLLOWER COUNT.

Imagine two creators.

One has 400,000 followers.

The other has 800.

The first creator posts motivational content.

Millions watch.

Thousands applaud.

People write:

"AMAZING!"

"SO INSPIRING!"

"YOU'RE THE BEST!"

But the creator doesn't have a clear product or service.

They don't know what their audience needs badly enough to purchase.

So monetization remains difficult.

Now consider the person with 800 followers.

She's a freelance website designer.

Her audience includes restaurant owners, small-business operators, and entrepreneurs.

One afternoon, she publishes a post:

"IS YOUR WEBSITE LOSING CUSTOMERS? HERE ARE FIVE COMMON REASONS."

Only 250 people see it.

Twelve people like it.

Two comment.

But one restaurant owner sends a private message.

"Can you help redesign my website?"

They arrange a meeting.

She presents her proposal.

The restaurant owner agrees to pay $1,500.

ONE POST. 250 VIEWS. ONE CUSTOMER. $1,500 IN REVENUE.

Now imagine she secures four similar projects.

That's $6,000 in gross revenue before expenses and taxes.

These are hypothetical examples, not guaranteed outcomes.

But here's the lesson.

YOU DON'T NECESSARILY NEED 100,000 PEOPLE TO NOTICE YOU.

YOU NEED THE RIGHT PEOPLE TO UNDERSTAND THE VALUE YOU PROVIDE.

One serious buyer can be more commercially valuable than thousands of passive viewers.

One long-term client can be worth more to your business than a viral post that produces no sales.

And one trusted recommendation can open doors that thousands of likes never could.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 HERE'S A QUESTION MOST ENTREPRENEURS DON'T WANT TO ANSWER.

Are you building a business?

Or are you building an audience because the numbers make you feel like you're progressing?

Think about that.

Every day, people say:

"I'll start selling when I reach 10,000 followers."

"I'll contact clients when my website is finished."

"I'll launch after I buy a better camera."

"I'll start when I have more experience."

"I'll begin when my branding looks professional."

"I'll make my offer when I feel confident."

But here's what happens.

Monday becomes Friday.

Friday becomes next month.

Next month becomes next year.

And the dream remains exactly where it started.

Meanwhile…

Someone with 100 followers sends their first proposal.

Someone with an ordinary smartphone records a helpful video.

Someone with a simple landing page gets a customer inquiry.

Someone with no online audience contacts a local company and wins a project.

Someone who was terrified of rejection makes their first sales call.

Not every attempt succeeds.

Some people hear "NO" dozens of times.

Some offers need improvement.

Some businesses take years to become profitable.

But at least they're discovering what works.

YOU CANNOT IMPROVE AN OFFER YOU NEVER MAKE.

And you cannot build a customer relationship with someone you never contact.

Sometimes the biggest obstacle isn't the algorithm.

It's the decision to keep preparing instead of beginning.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

❤️ IF YOU HAVE FEWER THAN 1,000 FOLLOWERS, I WANT YOU TO READ THIS VERY CAREFULLY.

Please stop calling your audience small.

Imagine walking into a room filled with 500 people.

Five hundred real human beings.

Imagine standing in front of them.

Would you say:

"ONLY 500 PEOPLE CAME?"

Probably not.

You would see a room full of potential connections.

People with dreams.

People with families.

People running businesses.

People looking for solutions.

People who might benefit from something you know.

Now imagine that just five of those people genuinely need your service.

And two eventually become customers.

Would those 500 people still seem insignificant?

YOUR NEXT CUSTOMER MIGHT ALREADY BE FOLLOWING YOU.

Your next business partner might already be reading your posts.

Your next referral might come from someone who has never commented.

Your next opportunity might be hidden inside an audience you've been dismissing.

Yet so many creators are obsessed with attracting another 10,000 strangers that they overlook the people already paying attention.

STOP TREATING YOUR CURRENT FOLLOWERS LIKE THEY DON'T MATTER JUST BECAUSE THERE AREN'T ENOUGH OF THEM TO IMPRESS OTHER PEOPLE.

Every meaningful relationship starts with one person.

Every loyal customer was once a stranger.

Every successful business had a beginning.

And every large audience was once small.

💬 COMMENT YOUR CURRENT FOLLOWER COUNT BELOW.

100?

500?

1,000?

5,000?

50,000?

Whatever the number, don't be embarrassed.

I want people to see that they're not alone in their journey.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💰 WHAT IF YOU SPENT THE NEXT 30 DAYS CHASING CUSTOMERS INSTEAD OF FOLLOWERS?

Imagine changing your priorities.

Instead of trying to reach 100,000 followers…

You focus on getting your first paying customer.

Instead of checking your likes every 15 minutes…

You contact five potential clients.

Instead of worrying about whether your video will go viral…

You create content that answers a real customer question.

Instead of comparing your numbers with strangers…

You improve your offer.

Instead of obsessing over your next thousand followers…

You build stronger relationships with the people already interested in your work.

Your goals become:

🎯 Five genuine conversations with potential customers.

🤝 Three new professional relationships.

📧 Ten qualified business inquiries.

💳 Your first sale or your next profitable sale.

⭐ One satisfied customer willing to recommend you.

🔁 One customer who returns because you delivered excellent value.

Imagine reaching the end of those 30 days.

Maybe you gained only 50 followers.

But you also gained two paying customers.

You learned what people actually need.

You improved your sales conversations.

You built confidence.

You discovered which offers attract interest.

WOULD YOU REALLY CALL THAT A BAD MONTH?

Because business growth isn't always visible in your follower count.

Sometimes it's happening in your inbox.

Sometimes it's happening during a client meeting.

Sometimes it's happening through a referral.

Sometimes it's happening when a satisfied customer says:

"I KNOW SOMEONE ELSE WHO NEEDS YOUR HELP."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💔 SOMEONE READING THIS RIGHT NOW IS CLOSE TO GIVING UP.

Maybe that's you.

Maybe you've spent months posting without much engagement.

Maybe you've watched creators who started after you reach 100,000 followers.

Maybe you've spent money on software, courses, and tools.

Maybe your family doesn't understand what you're trying to build.

Maybe you've begun questioning whether you have what it takes.

And every time you open social media…

You see another success story.

Another creator celebrating a million views.

Another entrepreneur showing off a luxury car.

Another person claiming to earn thousands every day.

And quietly, you wonder:

"WHY ISN'T THAT HAPPENING FOR ME?"

But here's something I want you to consider.

YOU ARE COMPARING YOUR ENTIRE LIFE WITH THE SMALL PART OF SOMEONE ELSE'S LIFE THEY CHOOSE TO SHOW YOU.

You don't know their expenses.

You don't know their debt.

You don't know their profit.

You don't know how many years they struggled.

You don't know whether their impressive revenue figures translate into actual take-home income.

And you certainly don't know whether their success would make you happy.

So please don't measure your worth against someone else's follower count.

Your 300 followers do not make you a failure.

Your 20 likes do not make your work meaningless.

Your slow progress does not mean your goals are impossible.

You may need to change your strategy.

You may need to improve your offer.

You may need to learn new skills.

You may need to keep experimenting.

But none of that means you should feel ashamed of where you're starting.

YOU DON'T NEED TO IMPRESS THE ENTIRE INTERNET TO BUILD SOMETHING THAT CHANGES YOUR LIFE.

And if you've been feeling discouraged lately…

❤️ Leave a heart in the comments.

You might be surprised how many people feel exactly the same way.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 I WANT TO TURN THIS COMMENT SECTION INTO SOMETHING MORE VALUABLE THAN A THOUSAND LIKES.

Let's help each other.

If you've ever made money online with a small audience, tell us your story.

Maybe you sold a digital product.

Maybe you landed a freelance client.

Maybe you offered marketing services.

Maybe you built a website for someone.

Maybe you sold handmade products.

Maybe you helped a local business.

Maybe you earned your first $50 with fewer than 100 followers.

YOUR STORY MATTERS.

Not because of the amount you earned.

But because someone reading this might be waiting for proof that starting small is possible.

👇 IF YOU'VE ALREADY MADE YOUR FIRST SALE, COMMENT:

"MY FIRST SALE WAS ______ AND I HAD ______ FOLLOWERS."

Tell us what you offered.

Tell us how you found the customer.

Tell us what you learned.

And if you haven't made your first sale yet…

Comment:

🚀 "WORKING ON MY FIRST CUSTOMER."

Then tell us what business you're trying to build.

Perhaps another reader can share advice.

Perhaps you'll meet someone with a similar goal.

Perhaps someone will discover your service.

Let's create conversations that lead to genuine connections, not just another competition over who has the biggest numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 HERE'S MY 24-HOUR CHALLENGE TO EVERYONE READING THIS.

Before tomorrow, take one action that could move you closer to earning revenue.

Just one.

📧 Send that business proposal.

☎️ Make the call you've been avoiding.

🌐 Publish your landing page.

💬 Ask a potential customer what they need.

🤝 Reconnect with an old client.

💰 Create an offer with clear pricing.

text:
I agree that assessments need to evolve in the age of AI, but I wouldn't say pen-and-paper exams and in-person vivas are the only scalable solutions, particularly for large university classes with hundreds of students.

At Arizona State University, our CoRAL Lab has been exploring this challenge through three complementary EdTech tools:

IntegrityShield - Makes assessments more AI-resilient through document-level perturbations that reduce the reliability of AI-generated answers while preserving readability for students. The goal is to retain the scalability of digital assessments without making it easy to outsource answers to AI.🎥 Demo: https://t.co/1uHYLmXj8a

DraftTrace - Focuses on the process rather than just the final answer. It provides visibility into how students develop their written work, helping educators distinguish genuine student engagement from potentially AI-generated submissions. This offers an alternative to relying exclusively on AI-content detectors.🎥 Demo: https://t.co/UDwb9pJLc7

GamEDAI - Uses multi-agent AI to generate interactive, curriculum-aligned educational games that encourage students to apply concepts, solve problems, and demonstrate understanding through active participation rather than simply submitting answers.🎥 Demo: https://t.co/EKvNOam3XW

We've also started piloting these approaches in actual university courses, including large undergraduate and graduate classes.

I think in-person vivas and hands-on demonstrations are valuable, but they shouldn't be the only options. The bigger opportunity for EdTech is to rethink how we design, deliver, and evaluate learning in an AI-native world, making assessments authentic, AI-resilient, process-aware, and scalable.

Some more thoughts on the disgrace of Na(zi)Con in Jerusalem.

Almost all of the conference was classic right-wing: immigration, family values, national identity, and security. On Wednesday night (Oct 7), the conference hosted a panel on the American "new right". The participants repeatedly shifted between brave truth-tellers and outsider non-experts just sharing vibes. What followed was a Groyper shitshow.

The panelists were all unanimous that Jews need to stop speaking about antisemitism. As one speaker put it (I may be paraphrasing), charges of being a Nazi have no currency today. When challenged (by me) on whether they think that there is real antisemitism, or real Nazis, and what the response should be, they offered no answer.

Let's be clear - antisemitism is real, and its not confined to the Left. In the past few years, there have been mass murders of Jews by neo-Nazis at the Tree of Life Synagogue in Pittsburgh (2018), the Poway Chabad Synagogue (2019). Neo-Nazis coordinated attacks on synagogues in the Northeast and Midwest in 2018. The FBI foiled plots against synagogues in Colorado in 2019. This is of course without getting into the new darlings of the right - Tucker, Fuentes, Candance Owens, Daryl Cooper. Do the panelists believe them to be antisemitic? Are we allowed to say so? They all implied that calling them out is a form of "cancel culture".

The panelists repeated objectively false reasons for the decline in support for Israel, and not simply as descriptors. Again and again, they said (some implicitly and some more explicitly) that Israel manipulates America into costly Middle Eastern wars. This is simply a lie.

Over the past 50 years, the United States has gone to war to protect Kuwait, the Balkans, South Korea, the Philippines, Saudi Arabia and others. Americans have NEVER shed blood for Israel. Israel did not make the US conduct costly (and ultimately pointless) nation-building exercises in Iraq and Afghanistan. The recent was in Iran began when Trump promised Iranian protesters that "help is on the way". Israel, in fact, is probably America's most self-reliant and independent ally. Completely absent was any talk of American benefits to the alliance with Israel.

Then there was the usual canard about Israel taking American money. While I am sure most conference participants would support Israel weaning itself off of American aid, let's remember that the United States wants Israel to be reliant on aid as a tool of pressuring Israel. American aid is not charity - it must be invested in American technology and weapons. It is also being progressively phased out. Jordan and Egypt also receive over a billion dollar in foreign aid packages, but I've yet to hear hostility expressed towards these countries.

Finally, there was repeated talk of liberal Jewish American organizations, especially their support for immigration. The subtext was that Israeli Jews are somehow responsible for the policy choices of American Jews. As if there is some shadowy Jewish cabal to exploit America for Israel's sake.

The worst of all speakers was William Wolfe, who I would venture to say was the only speaker who I would characterize as an actual Jew-hater. He spoke of "Jewish" voting priorities that hurt him as an American Christian, implying that his opposition to Israel is a means of getting back at them. Let's be clear - American Jews are American citizens, and have every right to promote their political preferences. Israelis have nothing to do with that. 

Wolfe also believes that American Jews are conditional citizens. He spoke of pride of his ancestors having been in America since the Civil War, noting that no Jews signed the American constitution. So what? His implication was that they are not real or full Americans. (Somebody pointed out that Haim Solomon financed the Revolution). He also said that only one million Jews voted for Trump, out of 77 million Americans. Jews are the "junior partner" in conservatism and "need to know their place". He also spoke of his anger of American Jews largely voting Democratic. Again - so what? American Jews don't owe you anything.

Wolfe also claimed that he wanted an American-Israeli partnership devoid of religious or cultural meaning, purely transactional. And then he took Israel to task for selling drones to Azerbaijan, which in his words kill Christians in Armenia. Of course, Azerbaijan is a close ally of Israel, and sits on Iran's border. Armenia has close ties with Iran.

As an Orthodox Jew, its not my place to comment on Christian theology. But Wolfe took Evangelicals to task, saying that the "Old Testament" is a Christian book, for Christians, thus cutting off the Jewish roots of Christianity. In between the lines, Wolfe ascribes to classic supercessionism, in which Judaism has been replaced by Christianity and Jews have finished their historical role. That explains his antipathy to Israel and Zionism - the Jews are done and have no more right to statehood (or even existence as a group).

Hazony and co billed this event as having hard conversations, yet they objected to partipants who had serious concerns about the points raised, vigourously denying even the possibility of antisemitism or anti-Jewish undertones. Wolfe was combatant and intentionally provocative in private exchanges. He didn't come for conversation. He came for the applause of his Groyper twitter base at telling the Joos the truth to their face.

@NatConTalk is the right wing equivalent of Jews for Mamdani, putting their prefered policy preferences ahead of Jewish security and safety. Jews were silent as the Left was taken over by antizionists and extremists, for the sake of unity against the supposed greater enemy on the Right. This is the exact same dynamic that is happening of the Right. @yhazony has brought Groyper and neo-Nazis to Jerusalem. It is a disgrace. Proud Jews and Zionists should not go along with it.

Rhapsody Of Realities, Daily Devotional
PASTOR Chris Oyakhilome Ph.D
TOPIC: ✨WHICH COMPANY WOULD YOU RATHER KEEP?✨
Date: FRIDAY 9TH OCTOBER 2026

Scriptural Ref: Hebrews 12:22-23
But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God... To the general assembly and church of the firstborn... (Hebrews 12:22-23).

The people you admire reveal much about the values you cherish. Throughout history, men have celebrated warriors, kings, inventors, politicians, entertainers, and other notable figures whose achievements shaped the world around them. Yet, the Scriptures present us with a certain company of people who were praised and celebrated by God because they lived by faith and fulfilled His purpose in their generations.

When you read about Abraham, Moses, Esther, David, Daniel, Paul, and the other heroes of faith, you're not merely reading historical accounts. You're seeing examples of individuals who valued God's purpose above personal ambition and whose lives produced results that extended far beyond this world. They’re part of the great cloud of witnesses the Bible talks about (Hebrews 12:1). 

These were men and women whose faith, courage, obedience and devotion to God continue to inspire across generations. Their lives remind us that true greatness is not measured by worldly accomplishments but by faithfulness to God's calling. Read about them in Hebrews 11:4-38, and you’ll be greatly inspired.

As a child of God, you've been brought into their company; it’s a lineage of faith. You've become part of God's family, connected to His eternal purpose. Therefore, let your admiration be directed toward those who exemplify the values of the Kingdom. Learn from their faith. Follow their example.

*Choose your influences carefully and cultivate a heart that esteems the things God esteems.* When you identify with those who live for His purpose, they’ll inspire you to pursue the things that truly matter and build a life of lasting significance.

Thank God that in the Scriptures, He gave us a compendium of the inspiring lives of these men and women of faith. He got to the climax and told us about those amongst them who rejected deliverance; they would rather face certain death for the sake of God’s purpose and vision than accept deliverance. It’s better to be listed among and identified with the great heroes of faith in the Bible than to have all of the greatness that this world could ever offer. Hebrews 13:7 says, “Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.”

PRAYER
Dear Father, thank you for the examples of faith preserved for us in your Word. My heart is set on your purpose, and I value the things that matter to you. I walk in faith, courage and devotion, fulfilling your calling upon my life in glory and righteousness, in Jesus' Name. Amen.

FURTHER STUDY

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, [2] Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

[35] Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

Villena Challenger

 Laslo Djere vs Hynek Barton

Quarterfinal | 9 October | 15:00

🧠 Form & Context

Laslo Djere
🏆 Experience gap: The former top-30 player, aged 31, faces a 22-year-old ranked more than 100 places lower.

📈 Better recent results: His recent match-win rate is 64%, against Barton’s 57%.

💪 Solid in deciders this season: He has won 53% of deciding sets in 2026.

🎾 Reliable serve: He wins 69.9% of first-serve points and saves 60.2% of break points.
⚠️ Limited return threat: He wins 39% of return points and converted only 39% of break points recently.
Hynek Barton
🚀 Matching serve numbers: He edges Djere on first-serve points (71.2% against 69.9%) and second-serve points (51.6% against 50.0%).
🔒 Holding firm under pressure: He has saved 61% of break points in recent matches.

↩️ Level on return: He wins 40% of return points over his career, against Djere’s 39%.

📉 Weaker recent record: He is 4–6 in his last ten matches.
📊 Strong longer-term record: His career best-of-three win rate is 62%, against Djere’s 60%.

🔍 Match Breakdown
On serve and return, these two profiles are almost identical. Barton is marginally ahead on most service lines, and the career return figures differ by a single point. Both players should hold regularly.

That leaves the separation in results rather than point-level numbers. Djere has the better recent match-win rate and the better 2026 deciding-set record. His experience in tight situations is his main asset.

Barton’s last-ten record is the weakest in this match, and it is the main mark against him. His underlying numbers, however, suggest he has been more competitive than that record shows.

With few breaks expected, tiebreaks are likely. Their career tiebreak records are level at 49% and 50%, so these sets offer no clear edge for either player.

There is no previous meeting to draw on. Djere’s form and experience support him as favourite. Barton’s serve and return numbers, though, are good enough to keep this close, and the 1.44 price leaves little margin for a match decided by a handful of points.

7.Israel is about the same size as New Jersey and can fit into California 22 times. It has very limited natural resources and most of its land is desert.
8.Israel is a world leader in innovation and humanitarianism aid. Israelis are helping people all over the world overcome hunger, disease, water scarcity, war, terrorism, natural disasters, environmental degradation, cyber threats and much more.
9.Israel made peace with Egypt in 1979 and Jordan in 1994, followed by the UAE, Bahrain, and Sudan in 2020. Others in the region are likely to follow. Israelis have offered at least four major proposals to end the conflict with the Palestinians and help create a Palestinian state. Palestinian leaders have said no each time, to the detriment of both peoples.
10.Israel is one of the world’s most diverse nations and the only consistently free country in the Middle East, according to Freedom House. Israelis have successfully fought for progress on human rights issues like equality for minorities ( especially for the 1.8 million Arab citizens of Israel), women’s rights , LGBTQ rights, peace with Israel’s neighbors, and much more.
